name: codex-multimodel-subagent-router
description: Codex-led native and API subagent routing with immutable ownership, workspace leases, explicit compatibility gates, and no silent backend substitution.

interface.displayName: Codex 主控 · 多模型峰谷子代理
interface.shortDescription: Codex 主控按峰谷选择原生模型与 API 子代理，保留可信归属和租约
interface.longDescription: Source contracts support fixed and peak/valley selection of Luna, same, exact native models, isolated native_deepseek with its own provider and catalog, and API profiles. API profiles are immutable; credentials use a DeepSeek account or manual env/file references. API panel save is separate from explicit Apply. First-version API children disable built-in web search. Native routing is independent of the API compatibility guard. Current DeepSeek/API external calls and candidate MCP/GUI acceptance remain unverified. DSH is explicit legacy only. Installation identity changes preserve legacy storage and protocol identity.
